nodes.summary: For a set $A$ of natural numbers, $A + A$ is the set of natural numbers $n$ such that $n = a + b$ for some $a, b \in A$.
nodes.title: Sumset of a set of naturals

nodes.summary: Let $M$ be an additive commutative monoid, $A \subseteq M$ and $n$ a natural number. $A$ is an exact additive basis of order $n$ if every element of $M$ is a sum of exactly $n$ (not necessarily distinct) elements of $A$, that is, $M = nA$, where $nA = \{a_1 + \dots + a_n : a_1, \dots, a_n \in A\}$ and $0A = \{0\}$.
nodes.title: Exact additive basis of order $n$

nodes.summary: A set $A$ of natural numbers is an additive basis of order $2$ if there is a natural number $N$ such that every natural number $n \ge N$ can be written as $n = a + b$ with $a, b \in A$.
nodes.title: Additive basis of order 2

nodes.summary: Let $M$ be an additive commutative monoid, $A \subseteq M$ and $n$ a natural number. $A$ is an asymptotic additive basis of order $n$ if all but finitely many elements of $M$ are sums of exactly $n$ (not necessarily distinct) elements of $A$, that is, $M \setminus nA$ is finite, where $nA = \{a_1 + \dots + a_n : a_1, \dots, a_n \in A\}$ and $0A = \{0\}$.
nodes.title: Asymptotic additive basis of order $n$

nodes.summary: A subset $A$ of an additive commutative monoid $M$ is an asymptotic additive basis if there is a natural number $n$ such that $A$ is an asymptotic additive basis of order $n$, that is, all but finitely many elements of $M$ are sums of exactly $n$ (not necessarily distinct) elements of $A$.
nodes.title: Asymptotic additive basis

nodes.summary: A set $A$ of natural numbers is a minimal additive basis of order $2$ if it is an additive basis of order $2$ and, for every $a \in A$, infinitely many natural numbers do not lie in the sumset $(A \setminus \{a\}) + (A \setminus \{a\})$.
nodes.title: Minimal additive basis of order 2

nodes.summary: Let $M$ be an additive commutative monoid, $A \subseteq M$ and $n$ a natural number. $A$ is a weak additive basis of order $n$ if every element of $M$ is a sum of at most $n$ (not necessarily distinct) elements of $A$, that is, lies in $mA$ for some $m \le n$, where $mA = \{a_1 + \dots + a_m : a_1, \dots, a_m \in A\}$ and $0A = \{0\}$.
nodes.title: Weak additive basis of order $n$

nodes.summary: A subset $A$ of an additive commutative monoid $M$ is a weak additive basis if there is a natural number $n$ such that $A$ is a weak additive basis of order $n$, that is, every element of $M$ is a sum of at most $n$ (not necessarily distinct) elements of $A$.
nodes.title: Weak additive basis

nodes.summary: There are disjoint sets $A_1$ and $A_2$ of natural numbers, both additive bases of order $2$, such that no subset of $A_1 \cup A_2$ is a minimal additive basis of order $2$.
nodes.title: Erdős Problem 869 is false (Larsen)

nodes.summary: The statement that for all disjoint sets $A_1$ and $A_2$ of natural numbers that are both additive bases of order $2$, there is a set $B \subseteq A_1 \cup A_2$ that is a minimal additive basis of order $2$.
nodes.title: Erdős Problem 869 (disjoint bases and minimal bases)

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
